purpose: Check whether public Neurosetta legacy installation files bind the GeoJax/JAX dependency to an exact source or version near the historical Point_data artifact date.

dependency_introducing_commit.message: Branching Angles; Adds function to get branching angles. Also now has GeoJax as a dependency

setup_py.observed: Reads requirements.txt into a variable, but setup(...) does not pass install_requires=requirements.
Same setup.py blob; setup(...) still omits install_requires.

proven: By 2025-02-21 the public legacy Neurosetta source claimed GeoJax as a dependency and code additions subsequently imported GeoJax.
Neither the committed requirements.txt snapshot nor the later one names GeoJax or JAX.
The later environment.yml does list JAX but without a version pin and does not list GeoJax.
The observed setup.py reads requirements.txt but does not pass that list as install_requires to setuptools.
The public install metadata does not identify the source URL, commit SHA, package version, or installation mechanism for GeoJax.
not_proven: Whether the author installed GeoJax from a public Git URL, a local checkout, a wheel, or another private source.
Which GeoJax commit, JAX version, and jaxlib version were installed on 2025-12-09.
That the historical Point_data producer used the same environment as the later public consumer notebooks.

conclusion.impact: The public legacy repo supports GeoJax-family plausibility but cannot narrow the exact installed commit through dependency metadata. Keep the current public GeoJax head as a best public candidate only, not as an identified runtime.

packaging.metadata_observation: GeoJax had its own setup.py and documented a local editable source checkout install, but neither the GeoJax setup metadata nor README identifies which exact commit/working tree was used by Neurosetta.

proven: A packageable GeoJax source snapshot with version 0.2 existed publicly by 2025-05-02.
Its setup.py declares unpinned jax and jaxlib dependencies.
Its README documents local editable installation (pip install -e .).
not_proven: That Neurosetta installed GeoJax using this documented path.
That version 0.2 or this exact Git commit was installed in the December 2025 environment.
That the author did not use a later local checkout, private revision, or an already installed editable source tree.
